title: Lesson 1 - When to Reach for Prompt Builder: Scope, Fit, and How This Course Maps to the Exam
description: Given business requirements, identify when it's appropriate to use Prompt Builder.

questions.question: For the Salesforce Certified Agentforce Specialist exam, which set of facts is correct?
options: 50 multiple-choice questions, 90 minutes, a 65% pass, no prerequisite
60 multiple-choice questions and up to five unscored, 105 minutes, a 72% pass, no prerequisite
60 multiple-choice questions and up to five unscored, 120 minutes, a 72% pass, a required Platform Administrator certification
75 multiple-choice questions, 105 minutes, an 80% pass, no prerequisite
questions.explanation: The live exam guide states 60 multiple-choice questions and up to five unscored questions, 105 minutes, 72%, and no prerequisite, so the other option sets report the wrong count, the wrong duration, or the wrong pass mark.

questions.question: A requirement asks for a personalized welcome email drafted from each Contact record, tailored in tone and reused across the sales team. Which tool fits?
options: A scheduled Flow that updates a field
A prompt template in Prompt Builder, grounded in the Contact record
questions.explanation: The requirement is generated language grounded in record data, which is exactly the shape Prompt Builder serves, while a formula, a validation rule, and a Flow compute or enforce values rather than generate prose.

questions.question: The exam guide recommends which certification as a foundation for this exam, while stating it is not required?
questions.explanation: The guide lists the Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator (and Platform App Builder) as recommended, not required, while the general platform primer stays out of scope for this course.
